title: Adobe Acrobat Pro DC DLL Planting Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Adobe Acrobat Pro DC. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must open a malicious file. The specific flaw exists within the handling of DLL search paths.
